title: Stabilizer orbits and thick tensor ideals of dualizable K(n)-local spectra
summary: We classify the prime and radical ideals of the Lubin–Tate deformation ring invariant under an open Morava stabilizer subgroup, at every prime and positive height. This proves Chai's invariant-ideal conjecture in the standard finite-residue-field formulation. It also proves the Hovey–Strickland conjecture: the dualizable $`K(n)`$-local category has exactly $`n+2`$ thick tensor ideals, and its Balmer spectrum is a chain of $`n+1`$ points.
